domain_description: Detached single tea leaf photographed on a plain backdrop at 256x256. NOT the same imaging domain as the 200 in-situ field photographs.
usage_constraint: TRAINING ONLY. Studio images must never enter validation or test; held-out evaluation stays field-only so the domain gap is measured rather than exploited.

brown_blight.justification: Brown blight is a foliar blight of tea (Colletotrichum spp.); same symptom category as the target class.

gray_blight.justification: Gray blight (Pestalotiopsis spp.) is a foliar blight of tea; merged with brown blight into the single LEAF_BLIGHT target.

helopeltis.justification: Helopeltis theivora IS the tea mosquito bug. Same organism, different common name. Lesion morphology (dark punctate feeding wounds) matches the field MOSQUITO_BUG images.

algal_spot.justification: Tea "red rust" is caused by the alga Cephaleuros, the same pathogen genus as algal leaf spot. Visual check confirmed matching morphology: discrete small tan/orange circular lesions scattered on the blade, as in the field LEAF_RUST images.

excluded_source_classes.red_spot: Presents as large-area whole-leaf reddening/browning, not the discrete small spots seen in field LEAF_RUST. Visually distinct; lumping it in would inflate the class with a different condition.
excluded_source_classes.healthy: No corresponding target class in the FarmFederate schema.

schema_classes_without_studio_source.LEAF_HOPPERS: Dropped from the benchmark; images show no leafhopper symptoms.
